correctness.rationale: Every orbit enters odd integers at least five, since phi(n) is even for n>=3 and 1,2 route via 4 to 5. For any composite m>=27, its least prime factor gives phi(m)<=m-sqrt(m), so F(m)<m. For prime p>=29, F(p)=p+2; if p+2 composite there is strict descent within two steps, otherwise twin prime arithmetic gives 3|(p+4), hence F^3(p)<p. The resulting strictly decreasing odd block-endpoints must reach the eleven odd states 5..25. Exact evaluation of the forward-invariant eleven-state set gives precisely cycles (9),(11,13,15),(23,25); 25 on the last cycle proves sharpness. Fresh independent sieve verifies complete small-state table and local descent alternatives through 10000, which is supplementary to the infinite proof.
